chapters.name: 学术类对话-选课换课/研究课题（听力）

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.ex: This restaurant is famous for its specialty, fried dumplings.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅以特色菜煎饺而闻名。
words.en: A specialty is a particular area of study or expertise that someone has, or a product that is particularly associated with a specific place.

words.tr: phrase. 学术学科；学术领域
words.ex: Mathematics is an academic discipline.
words.ex_cn: 数学是一门学术学科。
words.en: An academic discipline is a branch of knowledge that is taught and researched at the college or university level. Disciplines are defined and recognized by the academic journals in which research is published, and the learned societies and academic departments or faculties to which their practitioners belong.

words.tr: phrase. 主修领域；主要专业方向
words.ex: His major field is computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他的主修专业是计算机科学。
words.en: The primary area of study or research that a student or scholar focuses on.

words.tr: phrase. 主修课程；专业课程
words.ex: She spent her first year taking major courses in psychology.
words.ex_cn: 她在大一的时候主修心理学课程。
words.en: A major course is the primary subject or area of study that a student chooses to focus on in their academic program.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.tr:
adj. 选举的；选修的；可选择的
n. 选修课程
words.ex: He voted in the elective process for mayor.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了市长的选举过程。
words.en: An elective course or subject is one that you can choose to study as part of your course, rather than one that you have to study.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.tr: phrase. 入门课程；基础课程；导论课
words.ex: He is taking an introductory course in math.
words.ex_cn: 他正在上一门数学入门课程。
words.en: An introductory course is a basic level course designed to introduce students to a subject or field of study.

words.tr:
v. 交叠；使部分重叠；
n. 重叠部分；
words.ex: The two colors overlap on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 两种颜色在墙上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

words.tr: 名词短语。课程描述；对一门课程的内容、目标、要求等的详细说明
words.ex: The course description provides an overview of the topics covered in the class.
words.ex_cn: 课程描述提供了课程涵盖主题的概述。
words.en: A summary or outline of the content, objectives, and requirements of a course.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.ex: He finished his coursework last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了他的课程作业。
words.en: Coursework refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.tr: phrase. 交换项目；交流项目（通常指学生或教师在不同学校、国家之间进行的学术交流）
words.ex: She participated in an exchange program to study abroad for a semester.
words.ex_cn: 她参加了一个交换项目，到国外学习了一个学期。
words.en: A program in which people from different countries or institutions visit each other's countries or institutions to study, work, or teach.

words.tr: phrase. 课程表；班级时间安排
words.ex: I check my class schedule every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一查看我的课程表。
words.en: A timetable showing the times at which events, especially classes in a school or university, are supposed to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 房间分配表；宿舍房间安排表
words.ex: Please check the room assignment sheet to find out your room number.
words.ex_cn: 请查看房间分配表以了解您的房间号。
words.en: A document or list that shows which rooms have been assigned to which people, often used in hotels, schools, or conferences.

words.tr: phrase. 退课；放弃某门课程
words.ex: She decided to drop class after realizing it was too difficult for her.
words.ex_cn: 她意识到课程对她来说太难后，决定退课。
words.en: To withdraw from a course or class that one is enrolled in.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.tr: phrase. 转学生；从一所学校转到另一所学校就读的学生
words.ex: The transfer student quickly adapted to the new school environment.
words.ex_cn: 转学生迅速适应了新学校的环境。
words.en: A student who moves from one educational institution to another.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: He submitted his academic record to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的学业成绩提交给了大学。
words.en: A document that provides a detailed account of a student's academic performance, including grades, courses taken, and degrees awarded.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: phrase. 高级学位；指在完成学士学位之后攻读的硕士或博士学位等更高层次的学术资格
words.ex: He wants an advanced degree in science.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个科学方面的高级学位。
words.en: An advanced degree is a university degree such as a master's or PhD, which is higher than a bachelor's degree.

words.tr: phrase. 高级研究；深造；进阶学习
words.ex: She is engaged in advanced study of quantum mechanics.
words.ex_cn: 她正在从事量子力学的高级研究。
words.en: A higher level of study or research in a particular field, often pursued after completing a basic or intermediate level of education.

words.tr: phrase. 带回家完成的考试；开卷笔试（通常允许学生在规定时间内在家作答并提交）
words.ex: He finished his take-home exam last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚完成了他的带回家考试。
words.en: An examination that students complete at home rather than in a classroom setting.

words.tr:
adj. 期中的
n. 期中考试
words.ex: He is preparing for his midterm exam next week.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为下周的期中考试做准备。
words.en: A midterm is an examination that is given in the middle of a term in a school or college.

words.ex: He studied hard for the mid-term exam.
words.ex_cn: 他为期中考试努力学习。
words.en: An examination taken in the middle of an academic term.

words.tr: phrase. 期末考试；最终考试
words.ex: He is preparing for the final exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为期末考试做准备。
words.en: A final exam is a test given at the end of a course of study to determine the student's knowledge and understanding of the material.

words.ex: The academic year starts in September.
words.ex_cn: 学年从九月开始。
words.en: The period of the year during which students attend school or university, usually from September to June.

words.ex: The new school year starts in September.
words.ex_cn: 新学年从九月开始。
words.en: The period of the year during which students attend school or university, typically from September to June.

words.ex: The answer is not guesswork; it's based on facts.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案不是猜测，而是基于事实的。
words.en: Guesswork is the process of trying to find the answer to something by guessing, rather than by using any exact method or calculation.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: The classic theory of supply and demand is fundamental to understanding economics.
words.ex_cn: 供需的经典理论是理解经济学的基本原理。
words.en: A traditional theory that is considered to be of fundamental importance in a particular field.

words.ex: The verification of the password took only a few seconds.
words.ex_cn: 密码的验证只花了几秒钟。
words.en: Verification is the process of establishing the truth, accuracy, or validity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 高级研讨会；高级研修班
words.ex: The advanced seminar on quantum physics attracted many experts.
words.ex_cn: 这个关于量子物理的高级研讨会吸引了许多专家。
words.en: A seminar that is designed for participants who have a high level of knowledge or skill in a particular subject.

words.ex: He left his job to join academia.
words.ex_cn: 他辞去了工作，进入了学术界。
words.en: Academia refers to the environment or community concerned with the pursuit of research, education, and scholarship.

words.tr: phrase. 学期项目；指在学期中完成的综合性研究或实践作业
words.ex: The term project required us to design and implement a software solution.
words.ex_cn: 学期项目要求我们设计和实现一个软件解决方案。
words.en: A term project is a significant task or assignment that students are required to complete over the course of a semester, often involving research, analysis, and presentation of findings.

words.tr: phrase. 自主学习；独立研究（课程）
words.ex: He does independent study every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上进行自主学习。
words.en: A method of learning where the student takes responsibility for their own learning process, often outside of a traditional classroom setting.

words.tr: phrase. 独立研究项目；自主研究课题
words.ex: She successfully completed her independent research project on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 她成功完成了关于气候变化的独立研究项目。
words.en: An independent research project is a study or investigation conducted by an individual or a group without direct supervision, often as part of academic or scientific work.

words.tr: phrase. 团体研究；小组研究
words.ex: They are doing group research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在做关于气候变化的小组研究。
words.en: Group research refers to a collective effort by a group of individuals to investigate a particular topic or problem, often leading to shared findings and conclusions.

words.tr: phrase. 小组项目；团体作业
words.ex: Our group project on renewable energy sources received high praise from our professor.
words.ex_cn: 我们关于可再生能源的小组项目得到了教授的高度赞扬。
words.en: A group project is a task or assignment that requires a group of people to work together to complete it. It often involves collaboration, division of tasks, and collective responsibility for the outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 学术计划；学业规划
words.ex: She spent the weekend working on her academic plan for the next semester.
words.ex_cn: 她花了整个周末时间制定下学期的学术计划。
words.en: A detailed proposal for doing or achieving something in the academic field, including courses, research, and other educational activities.

words.tr: phrase. 研究课题；研究主题；论文题目
words.ex: Choosing a relevant research topic is crucial for the success of your study.
words.ex_cn: 选择一个相关的研究课题对你的研究成功至关重要。
words.en: A subject or issue that a person or organization is studying or investigating.

words.ex: He is working on a research project about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做一个关于气候变化的研究项目。
words.en: A research project is a detailed and careful study of a specific topic or problem, often carried out over a period of time and involving the collection and analysis of information.

words.tr: phrase. 深入研究；深入调研；全面细致的调查
words.ex: The scientist did in-depth research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家对气候变化进行了深入研究。
words.en: Thorough and comprehensive investigation or study into a subject or topic to achieve a detailed understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 候补名单；等候名单
words.ex: I added my name to the waiting list for the concert tickets.
words.ex_cn: 我把名字加到了音乐会门票的候补名单上。
words.en: A waiting list is a list of people who have asked for something that is not immediately available, but who will receive it when it becomes available.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr: phrase. 野外工作站；现场观测站
words.ex: The biologists set up a field station to study the local wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 生物学家们建立了一个野外工作站来研究当地的野生动植物。
words.en: A field station is a facility located away from the main institution, used by scientists and researchers for conducting studies in the natural environment.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 研究基金；科研经费
words.ex: He got a research fund to study climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一笔研究经费来研究气候变化。
words.en: A sum of money set aside or given by an organization or government for conducting research.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

chapters.name: 学术类对话-作业与论文（听力）

words.tr: phrase. 办公时间；营业时间；教师答疑时间
words.ex: The teacher is available during office hours.
words.ex_cn: 老师在办公时间有空。
words.en: The times during which a person, especially a professional, is available for consultation or work in their office.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr: phrase. 课堂笔记；课程记录
words.ex: I reviewed my class note before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我在考试前复习了我的课堂笔记。
words.en: Written notes taken during a class or lecture.

words.tr: phrase. 课堂展示；班级演讲
words.ex: During the class presentation, the students shared their research findings on renewable energy.
words.ex_cn: 在课堂报告中，学生们分享了他们在可再生能源方面的研究成果。
words.en: A class presentation is a talk given by a student or a group of students in front of their classmates and teacher, often as part of their coursework or assessment.

words.tr: phrase. 春假（尤指美国学校在春季的假期）
words.ex: Many students travel during spring break to enjoy the warm weather.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在春假期间旅行，享受温暖的天气。
words.en: A vacation period in early spring at universities and schools in some countries.

words.ex: Students look forward to their summer break every year.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每年都期待暑假的到来。
words.en: A summer break is a period of time in the summer during which students and teachers are on vacation from school.

words.tr: phrase. 暑期学期：指复活节假期后立即开始，直到学年结束的时期。
words.ex: The summer term usually starts right after the Easter break.
words.ex_cn: 暑期学期通常在复活节假期后立即开始。
words.en: The summer term is the period during which summer school is in session, typically lasting from June to August.

words.tr: phrase. 暑期学校项目；指在暑假期间开设的教育课程或学习计划
words.ex: The summer school program offers a variety of courses for students to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 暑期学校项目为学生提供了多种课程选择。
words.en: A summer school program is an educational program offered by schools, colleges, or universities during the summer vacation. It allows students to take courses for credit, catch up on studies, or explore new subjects.

words.tr:
adj. 与安息日有关的
n. （大学教师每七年一次的）公休假
words.ex: He took a sabbatical from university to write a book.
words.ex_cn: 他从大学请假一年去写书。
words.en: A sabbatical is a period of paid leave granted to a university teacher or other worker for study or travel, traditionally one year for every seven years worked.

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 到期日；截止日期；预产期
words.ex: The due date for the homework is Friday.
words.ex_cn: 作业的截止日期是星期五。
words.en: The date by which something is expected to happen or be completed.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr: phrase. 论文主题；论文题目
words.ex: Choosing the right paper topic is crucial for the success of your research.
words.ex_cn: 选择正确的论文主题对你的研究成功至关重要。
words.en: A subject or theme that is chosen for a paper or essay, often reflecting the writer's interest or the requirements of the assignment.

words.tr: phrase. 研究论文；学术论文
words.ex: He wrote a research paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的研究论文。
words.en: A research paper is a piece of academic writing that provides analysis, interpretation, and argument based on in-depth independent research.

words.tr: phrase. 学期论文；学期报告（通常为大学课程结束时提交的学术论文）
words.ex: He wrote a term paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学期论文。
words.en: A term paper is a research paper written by students over an academic term, accounting for a large part of a grade.

words.tr: phrase. （大学生）毕业论文；高年级学生撰写的学术论文
words.ex: Writing a senior thesis is a significant part of the academic journey.
words.ex_cn: 撰写毕业论文是学术旅程中的重要部分。
words.en: A senior thesis is a substantial piece of scholarly work required of a student in their final year of undergraduate study, often involving original research or a comprehensive analysis of a topic.

words.tr: phrase. 论文研讨会；指围绕学位论文选题、研究方法或成果进行讨论与指导的学术研讨课程或会议
words.ex: She presented her thesis seminar to the department, showcasing her research findings.
words.ex_cn: 她在系里展示了她的论文研讨会，展示了她的研究成果。
words.en: A thesis seminar is a formal presentation or discussion of a thesis or dissertation, often as part of an academic course or degree requirement.

words.tr: phrase. 研究期刊；学术期刊；发表原创研究成果的定期刊物
words.ex: The research journal publishes articles on the latest scientific discoveries.
words.ex_cn: 这本期刊发表关于最新科学发现的论文。
words.en: A research journal is a periodical publication intended to further the progress of science, usually by reporting new research.

words.tr: phrase. 学术期刊；指发表学术研究成果、经过同行评审的专业出版物
words.ex: The findings of the study were published in a prestigious scholarly journal.
words.ex_cn: 该研究的结果发表在一份享有盛誉的学术期刊上。
words.en: A scholarly journal is a periodical publication in which scholarship relating to a particular academic discipline is published.

words.tr: phrase. 期刊论文；学术期刊文章
words.ex: He read a journal article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一篇关于气候变化的期刊文章。
words.en: A journal article is a piece of writing published in a journal or magazine, often presenting the results of research.

words.tr: phrase. 文献综述；文献回顾
words.ex: He wrote a literature review for his research paper.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的研究论文写了一篇文献综述。
words.en: A literature review is a survey of scholarly sources on a specific topic. It provides an overview of current knowledge, allowing you to identify relevant theories, methods, and gaps in the existing research.

words.ex: He submitted the documentation for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了项目的文件。
words.en: Documentation refers to the act of providing documents or the documents themselves, which serve as evidence or records of something.

words.tr: phrase. 补充阅读材料；附加的阅读内容
words.ex: The teacher recommended supplemental reading to enhance our understanding of the topic.
words.ex_cn: 老师推荐了补充阅读材料，以增进我们对主题的理解。
words.en: Additional reading material provided to enhance understanding or knowledge on a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 附加的阅读材料；额外的读物
words.ex: The teacher recommended some additional reading for better understanding of the topic.
words.ex_cn: 老师推荐了一些补充阅读材料，以便更好地理解这个主题。
words.en: Supplementary material provided to students to enhance their understanding of a subject.

words.tr: phrase. 背景阅读；为了解某个主题而进行的预备性阅读材料
words.ex: He did some background reading before the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课前做了一些背景阅读。
words.en: Reading material that provides background information on a particular topic.

words.tr: phrase. 额外阅读；补充阅读材料
words.ex: She does extra reading to improve her understanding of the subject.
words.ex_cn: 她通过额外阅读来提高对该学科的理解。
words.en: Additional reading materials provided to supplement the main curriculum or to enhance understanding of a subject.

words.ex: His writing style is simple and clear.
words.ex_cn: 他的写作风格简单而清晰。
words.en: The manner in which a writer chooses to write to their audience, encompassing their choice of words, sentence structure, and tone.

words.tr: phrase. 学术规范；学术惯例
words.ex: He followed academic convention in his research paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在研究论文中遵循了学术规范。
words.en: A set of agreed, stipulated, or generally accepted standards, norms, or criteria in the academic community.

words.tr: phrase. 逻辑顺序；合乎逻辑的次序
words.ex: The report was presented in a logical order, making it easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 报告按照逻辑顺序呈现，易于理解。
words.en: A sequence or arrangement of ideas or events that follows a reasonable and coherent pattern.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.tr: adj. 发育良好的；发展良好的
words.ex: The child has a well-developed body.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子身体发育良好。
words.en: A well-developed thing has grown or been made to a high level of complexity or sophistication.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.tr: phrase. 主要论点；核心论据
words.ex: The main argument of the essay is that climate change is a pressing global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章的主要论点是气候变化是一个紧迫的全球性问题。
words.en: The principal contention or point in a discussion or debate.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.ex: It's a paradox that he is rich but unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个悖论，他很富有却不快乐。
words.en: A paradox is a statement that seems to contradict itself but may nonetheless be true, or a situation that defies intuition.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: He generalized the results from the small group to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他将小群体的结果概括为全体情况。
words.en: If you generalize, you say something that seems to be true in most situations or for most people, but that may not be completely true in all cases.

words.ex: Can you summarize the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarize something, you give a brief description of its main points.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.ex: He tries to synthesize ideas from different books.
words.ex_cn: 他试图综合来自不同书籍的想法。
words.en: To synthesize means to combine different ideas, influences, or objects into a new whole, or to produce a substance by a chemical reaction in plants or animals.

words.ex: He gave a synopsis of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他简要介绍了这部电影。
words.en: A synopsis is a brief summary or general survey of something.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.ex: He went off topic during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中跑题了。
words.en: Not related to the subject being discussed.

words.ex: His opinion is subjective and not based on facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点是主观的，不是基于事实的。
words.en: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.

words.ex: He judged the case objectively.
words.ex_cn: 他客观地评判了这个案件。
words.en: In a way that is not influenced by personal feelings or opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 原创思维；独创性思考；新颖独到的见解
words.ex: Original thinking is highly valued in creative industries.
words.ex_cn: n. 在创意产业中，原创思维受到高度重视。
words.en: Original thinking refers to the ability to think independently and creatively, producing new and unique ideas.

words.tr: adv. 严重地；批评地；危急地；
words.ex: The patient is critically ill.
words.ex_cn: 病人病情严重。
words.en: In a way that involves the objective analysis and judgment of the merits and faults of a work of literature, music, or art.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.ex: From my point of view, this is the best choice.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这是最好的选择。
words.en: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.

words.tr: phrase. 草稿版本；初步版本
words.ex: He wrote a draft version of his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇论文的初稿。
words.en: An early or preliminary version of a document or plan.

words.ex: A primary source is an original document or object which was created at the time of the event or subject under study.
words.ex_cn: 原始资料是在事件发生时或研究主题时创建的原始文档或对象。
words.en: A primary source is an original document or physical object which was written or created during the time under study.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: The manager oversees the team's daily work.
words.ex_cn: 经理监督团队的日常工作。
words.en: To oversee means to watch and direct a piece of work, the people doing it, or the way it is done in order to ensure that it is done correctly.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.ex: He will redo his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后会重做作业。
words.en: To do something again or differently, especially in order to improve it or correct a mistake.

words.tr: phrase. 进度报告；进展报告；工作汇报
words.ex: He gave his teacher a progress report.
words.ex_cn: 他给老师交了一份进度报告。
words.en: A document that provides information on the current status or development of a project or activity.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: v. 重新上架；重新摆放
words.ex: The store manager decided to re-shelve all the books in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 商店经理决定按字母顺序重新上架所有书籍。
words.en: To put books or other items back onto shelves after they have been moved or used.

words.ex: As a member of the library, you have borrowing privileges for up to 5 books at a time.
words.ex_cn: 作为图书馆的会员，你可以一次借阅最多5本书的借阅特权。
words.en: The right or permission to borrow something, especially books from a library or money from a financial institution.

words.tr: phrase. 借阅期；贷款期限；借出期间
words.ex: The loan period for books is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的借阅期是两周。
words.en: The duration for which something, especially a book from a library, is borrowed.

words.tr: phrase. 流通记录；借阅历史（指图书或其他资料在图书馆系统中的借还记录）
words.ex: The librarian checked his circulation history.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员查看了他的借阅记录。
words.en: The record of how often and by whom a particular item has been borrowed or used in a library.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: My passport will expire next month.
words.ex_cn: 我的护照下个月到期。
words.en: If something such as a contract or a visa expires, it comes to an end or is no longer valid.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.tr: phrase. 预留的；保留的；专供备用（或预约）的
words.ex: The book you requested is on reserve at the library.
words.ex_cn: 你请求的书在图书馆被保留了。
words.en: If something is on reserve, it is being kept for a particular purpose or person and is not available for others to use.

words.tr: phrase. 预约书；保留图书（图书馆中为特定读者预留、暂不外借的藏书）
words.ex: The library has a section for reserved books that students can check out for a limited time.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有一个预约图书区，学生可以在有限的时间内借阅。
words.en: A reserved book is a book that has been set aside for a specific person to borrow, usually for a limited period of time.

words.ex: The company announced a stock buyback program to increase shareholder value.
words.ex_cn: 该公司宣布了一项股票回购计划，以提高股东价值。
words.en: A buyback is a financial transaction in which a company buys back its own shares from the marketplace, reducing the number of outstanding shares.

words.tr: phrase. 卖回；回购（指将已购买的商品或证券等再卖回给原卖方）
words.ex: The company decided to sell back some of its shares to the public.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定向公众回购部分股票。
words.en: To sell something back means to sell it again to the person or company from whom it was bought, often because it is no longer wanted or needed.

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.ex: He needs authorization to enter the room.
words.ex_cn: 他需要获得授权才能进入房间。
words.en: Authorization is the act of giving someone the power or right to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 经授权的访问；被允许的进入或使用权限
words.ex: The system ensures authorized access through multi-factor authentication.
words.ex_cn: 该系统通过多因素认证确保授权访问。
words.en: Permission granted to access a system, data, or area, typically given by someone in authority.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊许可；特别批准
words.ex: He needs special permission to enter the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他需要特别许可才能进入实验室。
words.en: Special permission refers to an authorization that is granted under exceptional circumstances, allowing someone to do something that is not normally permitted.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.tr: phrase. 特藏；专题馆藏（指图书馆或机构中具有特殊价值或主题的收藏品）
words.ex: The library has a special collection of rare books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有一个珍本书的特别收藏。
words.en: A special collection refers to a group of items that are particularly valuable, rare, or of significant interest, often held in a library, museum, or archive.

words.tr: phrase. 永久收藏；常设馆藏
words.ex: The museum's permanent collection includes works by famous artists from the Renaissance period.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆的永久收藏包括文艺复兴时期著名艺术家的作品。
words.en: A permanent collection refers to a set of items or artworks that are owned by a museum or gallery and are on display or available for viewing on a long-term basis, as opposed to temporary or special exhibitions.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆馆藏；图书馆所藏全部资料（包括书籍、期刊、音像资料等）
words.ex: The library holdings include over a million books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆馆藏包括超过一百万本图书。
words.en: The collection of books and other materials held by a library.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书区；参考资料部分；文献引用部分
words.ex: He checked the reference section for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考文献区查找那本书。
words.en: The part of a library where reference materials, such as encyclopedias and dictionaries, are kept for in-library use only.

words.ex: The books are on the reference stacks.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在参考书架上。
words.en: The shelves in a library that house the reference collection, which is for in-library consultation and not for borrowing.

words.tr: phrase. 电子格式，指信息以电子方式存储或传输的形式，如PDF、Word文档等
words.ex: The book is available in electronic format.
words.ex_cn: 这本书以电子格式提供。
words.en: A way of storing or transmitting information in a form that can be processed by computers.

words.tr: phrase. 电子资源；指以电子形式存储和访问的信息资源，如数据库、电子书、在线期刊等
words.ex: The library provides access to a wide range of electronic resources.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆提供广泛的电子资源访问。
words.en: An electronic resource is any information source that a library provides access to in an electronic format.

words.ex: He used microfilm to save old newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用微缩胶片保存旧报纸。
words.en: Microfilm is a film on which documents or printed materials are photographed at a greatly reduced size for ease of storage.

words.tr: v. 复制；复印；再做一次；
words.ex: He duplicated the file to save a copy.
words.ex_cn: 他复制了该文件以保存一份副本。
words.en: To duplicate something means to make an exact copy of it.

words.ex: The print version of the book is now out of stock.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的印刷版本现已售罄。
words.en: A physical, printed edition of a book or document, as opposed to an electronic or digital version.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.tr: phrase. 额外的副本；附加的拷贝
words.ex: Please send me an additional copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我发一份额外的报告副本。
words.en: An extra copy of a book or resource held by a library, beyond the primary copy, to meet demand.

words.ex: The updated edition of the dictionary includes new words and definitions.
words.ex_cn: 这本词典的更新版包含了新词和定义。
words.en: A revised version of a publication that incorporates new information or corrections.

words.tr: phrase. 后期版本；修订版；再版
words.ex: The later edition of the book included corrections and additional chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的后期版本包含了修正和额外的章节。
words.en: A version of a text or work that is published after the original, often including revisions or additional content.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.tr: phrase. 珍本；善本；稀有书籍
words.ex: He bought a rare book at the old bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧书店买了一本稀有书籍。
words.en: A book that is not often found and is considered valuable because of its age, rarity, condition, or other factors.

words.ex: He looked at the catalog to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalog is a list of things, such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: The professor provided a comprehensive book list for the course.
words.ex_cn: 教授为课程提供了一份详尽的书单。
words.en: A list of books, especially one that is compiled for a specific purpose, such as a reading list for a course.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: He added an annotation to the diagram.
words.ex_cn: 他在图表上添加了一个注释。
words.en: An annotation is a note or comment added to a text or diagram to explain or criticize it.

words.tr: n. 解说词；评论；实况报道；
words.ex: The commentator gave live commentary during the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 解说员在足球比赛期间进行了现场解说。
words.en: A commentary is a spoken or written description of an event or situation that is broadcast or published as it occurs.

words.tr: n. 加价；毛利；涨价幅度
words.ex: The store adds a 20% markup to the cost of goods.
words.ex_cn: 商店在商品成本上加了20%的利润。
words.en: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover overhead and profit.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆馆长；首席图书管理员
words.ex: The head librarian manages the entire library staff.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆长管理整个图书馆的员工。
words.en: The head librarian is the person in charge of a library, responsible for its management and operation.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆助理；图书管理员助理
words.ex: He works as a library assistant at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校担任图书管理员助理。
words.en: A library assistant is a person who helps in the running of a library, performing tasks such as organizing books, helping library users, and managing library resources.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.ex: The keyword helps you find the right page.
words.ex_cn: 这个关键词帮助你找到正确的页面。
words.en: A word or concept of great significance, especially in the context of information retrieval or search engine optimization.

words.tr: phrase. 视频库；影像资料库
words.ex: He borrowed a movie from the video library.
words.ex_cn: 他从视频图书馆借了一部电影。
words.en: A collection of videos that are available for viewing or borrowing, often organized in a systematic way.

words.ex: He used a magnifying glass to read the small print.
words.ex_cn: 他用放大镜看小字。
words.en: A magnifying glass is a convex lens which is used to produce a magnified image of an object.

words.ex: I need a photocopy of my passport.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一份护照的影印本。
words.en: A photocopy is a copy of a document made by a photocopier.

chapters.name: 校园生活-校内与社团活动（听力）

words.ex: The administrator fixed the computer system.
words.ex_cn: 管理人员修复了计算机系统。
words.en: An administrator is a person whose job involves helping to organize and supervise the way that an organization or institution functions.

words.tr: phrase. 行政办公室；管理部门
words.ex: He went to the administration office to get his ID card.
words.ex_cn: 他去行政办公室拿他的身份证。
words.en: The office or department within a library or educational institution responsible for its management and operations.

words.tr: phrase. 行政办公室；管理机构
words.ex: The administrative office handles all the paperwork for the university.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责处理大学的所有文书工作。
words.en: An administrative office is a place where the management and organization of a company, institution, or government department is carried out.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: He wants to go to graduate school after college.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学毕业后读研究生院。
words.en: A graduate school is a school that awards advanced academic degrees (such as master's and doctoral degrees) with the general requirement that students must have earned a previous undergraduate (bachelor's) degree.

words.ex: The passengers are aboard the plane.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在飞机上。
words.en: On or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.ex: The dean gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 院长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dean is a senior official in a college or university, who is in charge of a faculty or department or a group of students.

words.tr: phrase. 创始董事；创始人之一并担任董事职务的人
words.ex: The founding director played a crucial role in shaping the company's vision.
words.ex_cn: 创始董事在塑造公司愿景方面发挥了关键作用。
words.en: A founding director is a person who is one of the original members of the board of directors of a company and who has been involved in its establishment.

words.tr: phrase. 系主任；部门负责人
words.ex: The department chair speaks to students every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 系主任每周一和学生谈话。
words.en: The person who is in charge of a department in a college or university, responsible for its administration and academic programs.

words.tr: phrase. 审查委员会；评审委员会
words.ex: The review committee will evaluate the proposals and make recommendations.
words.ex_cn: 评审委员会将对提案进行评估并提出建议。
words.en: A review committee is a group of people appointed to assess or evaluate something, such as project proposals, academic papers, or performance.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr: phrase. 资深研究员；高级研究人员
words.ex: As a senior researcher, she has published numerous papers in top-tier journals.
words.ex_cn: 作为一名高级研究员，她在顶级期刊上发表了大量论文。
words.en: A senior researcher is someone who has a high level of expertise and experience in their field of research, often leading projects and mentoring junior researchers.

words.tr: phrase. 特邀演讲者；嘉宾发言人
words.ex: The guest speaker talked about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 特邀演讲者谈论了气候变化。
words.en: A guest speaker is someone who is invited to speak at an event or meeting, usually because of their expertise or experience in a particular field.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: He asked his advisor for help with his project.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问寻求项目帮助。
words.en: An advisor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their financial affairs or about their education.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.tr: n. 管理人；保管人；监护人
words.ex: The custodian takes care of the school building.
words.ex_cn: 管理人负责照顾学校大楼。
words.en: A custodian is someone who is responsible for looking after or protecting something valuable or important.

words.ex: The students walk to the lecture hall for class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们走向礼堂上课。
words.en: A large room in a college or university where lectures are given.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.tr: phrase. 膳食计划；饮食安排；餐食安排表
words.ex: She created a meal plan to help her lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 她制定了一个饮食计划来帮助她减肥。
words.en: A meal plan is a pre-arranged plan that specifies the timing, composition, and quantity of meals for a person or group, often used in institutions like schools or hospitals to ensure nutritional needs are met.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: He lives in the dorm with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dorm is a large building at a college or university where students live.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.ex: She works at the front desk of the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 她在酒店的前台工作。
words.en: The front desk is the place in a hotel, office building, or other establishment where visitors are greeted and dealt with.

words.ex: He asked for help at the information desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在信息台寻求帮助。
words.en: A place in a public building where you can go to get information.

words.tr: phrase. 主服务台；前台；总服务台
words.ex: Please go to the main desk for further assistance.
words.ex_cn: 请到总服务台寻求进一步帮助。
words.en: The main service point in a library where users can check out items, ask questions, and get assistance.

words.tr: phrase. 辅导中心：提供学生辅导和指导的机构或场所。
words.ex: The tutoring center offers personalized lessons to help students improve their grades.
words.ex_cn: 辅导中心提供个性化的课程，帮助学生提高成绩。
words.en: A tutoring center is a place where students can receive additional instruction or help with their studies outside of regular school hours.

words.tr: phrase. 姐妹大学（指与另一所大学建立合作关系、常进行学术交流的大学）
words.ex: The two universities have a long-standing sister university relationship.
words.ex_cn: 这两所大学有着长期的姐妹学校关系。
words.en: A sister university refers to a university that has a formal partnership or affiliation with another university, often for the purpose of academic collaboration, exchange programs, and research.

words.ex: He put a note on the bulletin board.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张便条贴在公告栏上。
words.en: A bulletin board is a board on a wall which notices can be pinned to.

words.ex: She spent hours writing her school paper on the history of ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 她花了几个小时写她的关于古罗马历史的学校论文。
words.en: A school paper is a newspaper or magazine that is produced by the students of a school.

words.ex: He handed out a flyer about the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一张关于音乐会的传单。
words.en: A flyer is a small handbill advertising an event or product.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.tr: phrase. （供编辑或审阅用的）案头副本，样书
words.ex: The publisher sent a desk copy to the professor for review.
words.ex_cn: 出版商给教授寄了一本赠阅本供其审阅。
words.en: A free copy of a book sent by a publisher to a teacher or reviewer for examination.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: Follow the guideline to complete the form.
words.ex_cn: 按照指导路线完成表格。
words.en: A guideline is a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: I received a notification on my phone.
words.ex_cn: 我收到了手机上的一条通知。
words.en: A notification is a message, sound, or symbol that tells you that something has happened or that you need to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 新生/新员工介绍会；迎新培训；情况说明会
words.ex: The orientation session starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 迎新会早上九点开始。
words.en: An orientation session is a meeting or series of meetings designed to introduce new members to an organization or environment, providing them with information and training to help them adapt and understand their roles.

words.tr: phrase. 口头陈述；口头报告；口头展示
words.ex: He gave an oral presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的口头报告。
words.en: An oral presentation is a formal, face-to-face speaking method intended to inform, persuade, or build goodwill towards a product, organization, or idea.

words.tr: n. 时事通讯；业务通讯；简报
words.ex: He reads the weekly newsletter every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都读这份周刊。
words.en: A newsletter is a regularly distributed publication that is generally about one main topic of interest to its subscribers.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.tr: n. 投票者；选民；选举人
words.ex: The voter cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 这位选民在选举中投了票。
words.en: A voter is a person who votes or has the right to vote in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 投票率；选民参与选举的比例
words.ex: The voting rate in the last election was surprisingly high.
words.ex_cn: 上次选举的投票率出乎意料地高。
words.en: The percentage of eligible voters who cast a ballot in an election.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.ex: The election will be held next month.
words.ex_cn: 选举将在下个月举行。
words.en: An election is a process in which people vote to choose a person or group of people to hold an official position.

words.ex: He will vote in the general election next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将参加大选投票。
words.en: A general election is an election in which all or most members of a given political body are chosen. These are usually held for a nation's primary legislative body, as distinguished from by-elections and local elections.

words.tr: phrase. 非正式民意调查；试探性投票
words.ex: They conducted a straw poll to gauge the level of support for the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次草草投票，以衡量对新政策的支持程度。
words.en: A straw poll is an informal survey of opinion, often used to get a quick sense of how a group feels about a particular issue.

words.tr: phrase. 学生政府；由学生组成的自治管理组织，负责代表学生利益并组织校园活动
words.ex: The student government organizes events to foster community spirit.
words.ex_cn: 学生政府组织活动以培养社区精神。
words.en: A student government is a group of students who are elected to represent the students in a school or college and to organize activities and events.

words.ex: The company aims to increase participation rates in its employee wellness program.
words.ex_cn: 公司旨在提高员工健康计划的参与率。
words.en: The proportion of a population that takes part in a particular activity or event, often expressed as a percentage.

words.tr: phrase. 新生入学指导；学生迎新活动
words.ex: The student orientation helps new students find their classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 新生入学指导帮助新生找到他们的教室。
words.en: An event or program designed to introduce new students to a school or university, its services, and its policies.

chapters.name: 校园生活-求职与工作（听力）

words.tr: phrase. 校园就业办公室，负责为在校学生和毕业生提供就业指导、招聘信息和职业发展服务的机构
words.ex: The campus employment office helps students find part-time jobs during their studies.
words.ex_cn: 校园就业办公室帮助学生在学习期间找到兼职工作。
words.en: A campus employment office is a department within a college or university that provides students with resources and assistance in finding employment, including part-time jobs, internships, and career advice.

words.tr: phrase. 职业服务中心（为学生或求职者提供职业规划、就业指导、简历修改、面试培训等服务的机构）
words.ex: The career services center offers various resources to help students find internships and jobs.
words.ex_cn: 职业服务中心提供各种资源，帮助学生找到实习和就业机会。
words.en: A career services center is a facility or department within an educational institution that provides students and alumni with resources and guidance for career planning, job searching, and professional development.

words.tr: phrase. 职业博览会；招聘会
words.ex: He went to the career fair to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业博览会找工作。
words.en: A career fair is an event where employers and recruiters meet with potential employees to discuss job opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 从课堂到合作的职业博览会；指连接学生、教育机构与企业合作的就业或实习招聘会
words.ex: The university organized a classroom-to-cooperation career fair to help students transition from academic life to professional work.
words.ex_cn: 大学组织了一场从课堂到合作职业博览会，以帮助学生从学术生活过渡到专业工作。
words.en: An event where students meet potential employers from various industries to explore career opportunities, often held in a collaborative setting.

words.tr: phrase. 面试工作坊；面试技巧培训
words.ex: The company organized an interview workshop to help candidates prepare for job interviews.
words.ex_cn: 公司组织了一个面试工作坊，帮助候选人准备求职面试。
words.en: A training session designed to prepare individuals for job interviews, covering techniques, common questions, and professional conduct.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: His submission to the boss ended the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他对老板的屈服结束了这场冲突。
words.en: The act of submitting something to someone for their decision or consideration; the state of being submissive or obedient.

words.tr: phrase. 潜在申请人；可能的候选人
words.ex: The job posting attracted a large number of potential applicants.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作招聘吸引了很多潜在的申请人。
words.en: A potential applicant is someone who may apply for a position or opportunity.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr: phrase. 职业推荐人；专业证明人；由前雇主或同事提供的、用于评估求职者能力与品行的书面或口头推荐
words.ex: He asked his old boss for a professional reference.
words.ex_cn: 他请他以前的老板给他开一份职业推荐信。
words.en: A person who can vouch for your character, skills, and work experience, often contacted by employers during the hiring process.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: He wrote a personal statement for his college application.
words.ex_cn: 他为大学申请写了一份个人陈述。
words.en: A personal statement is a written account of your personal history, achievements, and goals, often used as part of a college or job application.

words.tr: phrase. 良好声誉；正常状态（指个人或组织在法律、财务或社会关系方面无不良记录，处于合规或受认可的状态）
words.ex: The company is in good standing with the local community.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在当地社区中享有良好的信誉。
words.en: Good standing refers to the status of being respected or having a good reputation, especially in a professional or official context.

words.tr: phrase. 学术兴趣；指个人在学术领域中特别关注或热衷的研究方向或学科
words.ex: Her academic interests lie in the field of environmental science.
words.ex_cn: 她的学术兴趣在于环境科学领域。
words.en: Academic interests refer to the subjects or areas of study that a person is particularly interested in and wishes to explore or specialize in within an academic context.

words.tr: phrase. 兼职职位；非全职岗位
words.ex: She is looking for a part-time position to balance her studies and work.
words.ex_cn: 她正在寻找一个兼职职位来平衡她的学习和工作。
words.en: A part-time position refers to a job that requires fewer hours per week than a full-time job, often allowing for flexibility in scheduling.

words.ex: The company employs a number of part-timers to handle the increased workload during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 公司雇佣了一些兼职人员来处理假期期间增加的工作量。
words.en: People who work less than the usual or standard number of hours in a job.

words.tr: phrase. 校园工作；学校内的兼职或全职工作岗位
words.ex: She balances her studies with a campus job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 她在图书馆有一份校园工作，以平衡她的学业。
words.en: A job that is located on a university or college campus, typically available to students.

words.ex: He did an internship at a hospital last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他在一家医院实习。
words.en: An internship is a period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time. It is typically undertaken by students and graduates looking to gain relevant skills and experience in a particular field.

words.ex: He is a teaching assistant for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他是数学课的助教。
words.en: A teaching assistant is a person who helps a teacher in a classroom, often by providing support to students or helping with the preparation of lessons.

words.ex: The janitor cleans the school every night.
words.ex_cn: 门卫每天晚上打扫学校。
words.en: A janitor is a person whose job is to take care of a building, especially by cleaning it.

words.ex: Much of the legwork for the project was done by interns.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的大部分跑腿活都是实习生完成的。
words.en: Legwork refers to the work involved in gathering information or doing practical tasks, often involving travel or physical effort.

words.ex: He lives off-campus near the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校外，靠近公交站。
words.en: Located or occurring away from the campus of a university or college.

words.ex: He pays tuition fee every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期支付学费。
words.en: A tuition fee is the amount of money that you have to pay for being taught in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊情况；特定情境
words.ex: The judge considered the special circumstance of the case before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 法官在做出决定之前考虑了案件的特殊情况。
words.en: A special circumstance refers to an unusual condition or situation that is not typically encountered.

words.tr: phrase. 勤工俭学项目；半工半读计划
words.ex: The work-study program helped students finance their education while gaining valuable experience.
words.ex_cn: 工作学习计划帮助学生在获得宝贵经验的同时资助他们的教育。
words.en: A program that allows students to work part-time while attending school, often as a means of financial aid or to gain work experience.

words.ex: He got financial assistance from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从父母那里获得了经济援助。
words.en: Financial assistance refers to monetary support provided to individuals, organizations, or governments to help them with their financial needs.

words.tr: phrase. 财政援助；经济资助
words.ex: He got financial aid to pay for his books.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了经济援助来支付书本费用。
words.en: Financial aid refers to funding intended to help students pay education expenses including tuition, books, and living costs for study at post-secondary educational institutions.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr: n. 帮助台；超文本文档帮助信息
words.ex: He called the helpdesk for technical support.
words.ex_cn: 他打电话给帮助台寻求技术支持。
words.en: A helpdesk is a service that provides information and support to users of a computer system.

words.tr: phrase. 人力资源；人事部门
words.ex: The company hires new workers through human resources.
words.ex_cn: 公司通过人力资源部门招聘新员工。
words.en: Human resources is the department of a company that deals with the hiring, administration, and training of staff.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: phrase. 延长的营业时间；延长的工作时间
words.ex: The store offers extended hours during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在节日期间提供延长的营业时间。
words.en: Extended hours refer to periods of time that are longer than the usual or standard hours of operation.

words.ex: The work order specifies the materials needed for the repair.
words.ex_cn: 工作指令详细说明了修理所需的材料。
words.en: A work order is a document that provides details of a job that needs to be done, including what is to be done, by whom, and by when.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.tr: phrase. 工资结算期；薪资周期
words.ex: The pay period at our company is bi-weekly.
words.ex_cn: 我们公司的支付周期是每两周一次。
words.en: A pay period is a recurring length of time over which employee time is recorded and paid. Examples of pay periods are weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly.

words.ex: The company updated the payroll last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 公司上星期五更新了职工工资册。
words.en: A payroll is a list of employees and the amount of money they are to be paid, or the total amount of money paid to the employees of a company.

words.tr: phrase. 工资管理部门；发薪办公室
words.ex: The payroll office is responsible for calculating and distributing employee salaries.
words.ex_cn: 薪资部门负责计算和发放员工工资。
words.en: A payroll office is a department within a company or organization that is responsible for managing and distributing employee salaries.

words.tr: phrase. 薪资部门；负责员工工资核算与发放的部门
words.ex: The payroll department is responsible for calculating and distributing employee salaries.
words.ex_cn: 工资核算部门负责计算和发放员工工资。
words.en: The payroll department is the part of a company that is responsible for paying the employees.

words.ex: The advancement of technology helps people live better.
words.ex_cn: 技术的进步帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: The process of promoting a cause or plan; the act of moving forward or making progress.

words.tr: phrase. 人际交往能力；与人相处的技巧；人际沟通技巧
words.ex: He has good people skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中有很好的人际交往能力。
words.en: The ability to communicate effectively with others and to understand and influence their behavior.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.tr:
v. 剩下；留下；依然不变；
n. 遗迹；残余；遗体；
words.ex: Only two cookies remains on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上只剩下两块饼干了。
words.en: The parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 废墟；
v. 破坏；
words.ex: The old temple is now a ruin.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙现在已成为废墟。
words.en: Ruin means the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of disintegrating or being destroyed.

words.tr: phrase. 定居点遗址；人类聚居遗址
words.ex: Archaeologists discovered a settlement site dating back to the Bronze Age.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家发现了一个可追溯到青铜时代的定居点遗址。
words.en: A place where people have established a community or residence, often in a new or previously uninhabited area.

words.ex: The old shipwreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船的残骸躺在海底。
words.en: A shipwreck is the destruction of a ship at sea by sinking or breaking up, for example in a storm or after hitting a rock.

words.ex: The ancient tomb was filled with artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的坟墓里充满了文物。
words.en: A tomb is a place where a dead person is buried, especially a large, impressive structure.

words.tr: phrase. 埋葬地；墓地；安葬场所
words.ex: The archaeologists discovered ancient burial sites in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家在沙漠中发现了古代墓地。
words.en: Places where dead bodies are buried.

words.tr: phrase. 墓地；安葬场所；埋葬的地方
words.ex: Ancient kings had special burial places.
words.ex_cn: 古代的国王有专门的墓地。
words.en: Sites where the dead are interred.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.tr: phrase. 通道墓（史前时期的一种石墓，由一条狭长通道通向一个或多个墓室）
words.ex: Ancient people built passage graves for their dead.
words.ex_cn: 古人建造了通道式墓穴来安葬死者。
words.en: Passage graves are a type of burial mound or tomb characterized by a long, narrow passage leading to a burial chamber, often covered by earth or stone. They are found in various parts of Europe and are considered significant archaeological sites.

words.tr:
n. 藏物处；隐藏物；
v. 匿藏；
words.ex: The hunters found a cache of food under the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 猎人们在石头下发现了一个食物藏匿处。
words.en: A cache is a hidden store of things such as weapons or a supply of food.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: Prehistory is the time before writing was invented.
words.ex_cn: 史前是文字发明之前的时代。
words.en: The period of time before written records began, studied through archaeology and anthropology.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.tr: phrase. 古代社会；指历史上早期的、已消逝的文明或社会组织形式
words.ex: Ancient society built big temples for their gods.
words.ex_cn: 古代社会为他们的神建造了巨大的神庙。
words.en: An ancient society refers to the social structure and cultural practices of civilizations that existed in the distant past, often studied through archaeology and historical records.

words.tr: phrase. 古代历史；过去的事情（常指早已过时或不再相关的事）
words.ex: He thinks that ancient history is boring.
words.ex_cn: 他认为古代历史很无聊。
words.en: Ancient history refers to the aggregate of past events from the beginning of recorded human history to the Early Middle Ages or the Postclassical Era.

words.ex: The ancient civilization built big pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 这个古代文明建造了巨大的金字塔。
words.en: An ancient civilization refers to a society that has reached an advanced stage of social development and organization, often characterized by significant achievements in culture, technology, and governance, existing in the distant past.

words.tr: phrase. 失落的文明；已经消失的古代文明
words.ex: Archaeologists found relics of a lost civilization.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家发现了失落文明的遗迹。
words.en: A lost civilization refers to a society, culture, or nation that has disappeared or been forgotten, often leaving behind archaeological or historical evidence of its existence.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.tr: phrase. 仪式用物品；典礼器具（指在宗教仪式或正式典礼中使用的象征性物品）
words.ex: The museum displays ceremonial objects from ancient tribes.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自古代部落的仪式用品。
words.en: Objects used in ceremonies or rituals, often with symbolic significance.

words.tr: phrase. 宗教仪式；宗教典礼
words.ex: They perform a religious ritual every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上举行一场宗教仪式。
words.en: A religious ritual is a set of actions performed mainly for their symbolic value, which are prescribed by a religion or by the traditions of a community.

words.ex: They found an archaeological site near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们在河边发现了一个考古遗址。
words.en: Relating to the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains.

words.tr: phrase. 考古遗址；古代遗迹
words.ex: Tourists visit ancient archaeological sites in Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 游客参观埃及的古代考古遗址。
words.en: Archaeological sites are places where physical remains of past human activity are preserved, often excavated by archaeologists to study human history and prehistory.

words.tr: phrase. 考古记录；指通过考古发掘所获得的有关过去人类活动的所有实物证据和信息的总称
words.ex: The archaeological record shows ancient tools.
words.ex_cn: 考古记录显示了古代工具。
words.en: The archaeological record refers to the body of physical evidence about the past that is left behind by human activity, including artifacts, ecofacts, and features, which archaeologists study to understand past human behavior and societies.

words.tr: phrase. 考古发掘；考古挖掘
words.ex: Workers are doing an archaeological excavation near the old temple.
words.ex_cn: 工人们正在古庙附近进行考古发掘。
words.en: The process of digging up and studying the remains of past human life and activities.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: Workers excavate the old ruins with shovels.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用铲子挖掘古代遗址。
words.en: To excavate means to dig in the ground in order to find things that have been buried there, such as archaeological remains.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.tr: phrase. 挖掘现场；考古遗址
words.ex: Workers are digging at the excavation sites.
words.ex_cn: 工人们正在发掘现场挖掘。
words.en: Excavation sites refer to locations where digging is conducted to uncover archaeological or historical artifacts.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.tr: phrase. 追溯；回溯（指查明某事的起源或发展过程）
words.ex: We can trace back the history of this family to the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把这个家族的历史追溯到19世纪。
words.en: To find the origin or cause of something by examining the way in which it has developed.

words.tr: phrase. 化石碎片；指保存在岩石中的古代生物的部分遗骸或残片
words.ex: He found a fossil fragment in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 他在岩石中发现了一块化石碎片。
words.en: A piece or part of a fossil, which is the preserved remains or impression of a prehistoric organism.

words.ex: The fossil record shows how animals changed over time.
words.ex_cn: 化石记录展示了动物如何随时间变化。
words.en: The fossil record is the total number of fossils that have been discovered, as well as the information derived from them.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.tr: phrase. 实物证据；物证；有形证据
words.ex: The police found physical evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了物证。
words.en: Physical evidence refers to any material items that would be present at the crime scene, on the victims, or found in a suspect’s possession.

words.tr: phrase. 客户体验；顾客在与企业互动过程中所产生的整体感受
words.ex: The store improved customer experience by smiling and helping quickly.
words.ex_cn: 商店通过微笑和快速帮助改进了顾客体验。
words.en: The overall experience a customer has with a company or brand, especially in terms of their interactions and the quality of service they receive.

words.ex: The store offers rewards to build customer loyalty.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供奖励以培养顾客忠诚度。
words.en: Customer loyalty refers to the likelihood of repeat customers choosing a particular company's products or services over competitors' offerings.

words.tr: phrase. 顾客偏好；客户喜好
words.ex: The store changes products based on customer preference.
words.ex_cn: 商店根据顾客的偏好改变产品。
words.en: The particular liking or desire that customers have for certain products or services over others.

words.ex: The store grew its customer base by offering discounts.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店通过提供折扣扩大了客户群。
words.en: The group of customers who repeatedly purchase the goods or services of a business.

words.ex: The store talked to a potential customer yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 商店昨天和一个潜在客户交谈了。
words.en: A potential customer is someone who might be interested in buying a product or service from a company.

words.tr: phrase. 目标受众；预期观众；设定要传达信息的特定人群
words.ex: The book is written for its intended audience: young children.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为它的目标读者——儿童——写的。
words.en: The group of people that something, especially a book, advertisement, etc., is aimed at.

words.tr: phrase. 目标群体；特定受众；营销或研究中所针对的特定人群
words.ex: The ad is for a target group of teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告的目标群体是青少年。
words.en: A specific group of people identified as the intended audience or market for a product, service, or message.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.tr: phrase. 本票；期票；承诺付款的票据
words.ex: He signed promissory notes to borrow money.
words.ex_cn: 他签署了本票来借钱。
words.en: A promissory note is a financial instrument in which one party promises in writing to pay a determinate sum of money to the other, either at a fixed or determinable future time or on demand of the payee, under specific terms.

words.tr: phrase. 服务标准；指衡量服务质量的规范或准则
words.ex: The restaurant meets high service standard.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅达到了高标准的服务。
words.en: A service standard is a level of quality or attainment that is expected or required in the provision of a service.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.tr: adj. 不满意的；不高兴的； v. “dissatisfy”的过去式；
words.ex: He was dissatisfied with the service.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务不满意。
words.en: If you are dissatisfied with something, you are not contented or pleased with it.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He received compensation for his injured leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因腿部受伤获得了赔偿。
words.en: Compensation is something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 服务补救；指企业在服务失败后采取措施恢复客户满意度和忠诚度的过程
words.ex: The hotel did a good service recovery after the room was dirty.
words.ex_cn: 酒店在房间脏了之后很好地进行了服务补救。
words.en: Service recovery refers to the actions taken by a business to address and rectify a service failure, aiming to restore customer satisfaction and loyalty.

words.ex: He is learning business management at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习工商管理。
words.en: The process of planning, organizing, directing, and controlling the activities of a business or organization to achieve its objectives.

words.tr: phrase. 商业领袖；企业领导人
words.ex: The business leader helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 这位商业领袖帮助他的团队取得成功。
words.en: A business leader is a person who is in charge of a company or organization and makes important decisions.

words.ex: The business owner works every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业的老板每天工作。
words.en: A business owner is an individual who owns and operates a business, taking on the risks and rewards associated with the business.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.tr: phrase. 商务经理；业务主管
words.ex: The business manager plans the company's budget.
words.ex_cn: 业务经理制定公司的预算。
words.en: A business manager is a person who is responsible for the administration and financial management of a company or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 商务代表；业务代理人
words.ex: The business representative met the client at the office.
words.ex_cn: 业务代表在办公室会见了客户。
words.en: A business representative is a person who represents a company in dealing with clients or other businesses.

words.ex: He wrote a simple business plan to start a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份简单的商业计划来开一家咖啡店。
words.en: A business plan is a formal statement of business goals, reasons they are attainable, and plans for reaching them. It may also contain background information about the organization or team attempting to reach those goals.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
